slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on Creating an API Key
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Creating an API Key.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,
• Navigate to Google AI Studio.
• Generate a new API key.
• Copy and store the API key securely.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
Here I am using a browser on a computer.
You will need a web browser and an active Google account.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have Module 2: Art of the Prompt.

slides.title: Open Google AI Studio Website
slides.narration:
Open your web browser.
Navigate to **aistudio.google.com**.

slides.title: Sign In to Google AI Studio
slides.narration:
In the **top right corner**, click **Sign In**.
Select your **Google account**.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio sign-in page, with focus on Sign In button

slides.title: Navigate to Get API Key
slides.narration:
On the **left panel**, click **Get API Key**.
This opens the **API key management section**.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio interface, with focus on 'Get API Key' in the left panel

slides.title: Create a New API Key
slides.narration:
In the **center of the screen**, click **+ Create API key in new project**.
A new key appears.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio, with focus on '+ Create API key in new project' button and new key appearing

slides.title: Copy the Generated API Key
slides.narration:
Click the **copy icon** next to the new API key.
The key is copied to your clipboard.
Store it securely.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio, with focus on the copy icon next to the API key

slides.title: Verify API Key Creation
slides.narration:
Verify the new API key.
It is listed under **Your API Keys**.
Take note of the key.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio, with focus on the list of 'Your API Keys' with the new key highlighted

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we did.
We navigated Google AI Studio.
We generated a new API key.
We copied it securely.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
create another API key.
Explore options for restricting its usage.
Compare the results.
